test_objective: Check that if the target entity ID is faulty an error is raised
keywords: Merge an existing entity with a faulty ID

test_cases.name: 056_02_01 Merge an existing entity giving an invalid Id
test_cases.doc: Check that if the target entity ID is faulty an error is raised
test_cases.template: Merge an existing entity with a faulty ID
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entity_id}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Merge Entity and
    Query Parameter: entity_id set to 'invalidUri' and
    Query Parameter: entity_filename set to '${entity_replacement_filename}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
